title: "Triple Siege"
next_chapter_hook: "Ling Yuan said coldly with a sneer: 'Chen Ji? No, he has been dead for a long time.'"

text.content: "The thunderous roar still echoed in their ears as the Tianqing Sect's mountain gate formation shattered like broken glass, countless figures pouring in through the cracks. At the same time, earth-shaking battle cries came from the depths of the ruins—the three factions had arrived at precisely the same moment. Dust filled the sky, spiritual energy surged, and Chen Ji hid behind the rubble, his gaze cold and sharp as a blade. His breathing was barely audible, only his fingertips gently rubbing against the broken jade slip in his sleeve. The Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly hot, as if warning of something. The distant commotion grew closer, and he heard someone shout: 'Found him! The废物 of Tianqing Sect is right here!'"

dialogue.content: "废物? Hmph, is a废物 worth three factions striking simultaneously? Han Mou wants to see what kind of trickery is at play here!"

text.content: "Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, burst through the dust with his surrounding玄武法相 raging and surging. Behind him followed more than ten Inner Disciple, each with powerful auras and killing intent. However, their footsteps froze in unison when they saw the scene at the center of the ruins—the Imperial Court's Black Armored Imperial Guards were arranged in formation, the Demonic Path Holy Sect's purple-robed cultivators floated in the air, the three factions forming an eerie triangle with the collapsed altar at the center. And Chen Ji stood precisely at the center point of that triangle."

dialogue.content: "(A slight upturn at the corner of his lips, muttering softly) Three-way melee, what a good situation. Unfortunately... they don't seem to have decided whether to eliminate me first."

text.content: "The leaders of the three factions converged in the air. The Black Armored Commander of the Imperial Court coldly snorted: 'Xuanwu Sect's reach is long enough—these ruins were discovered by our dynasty first.' The purple-robed cultivator from the Demonic Path Holy Sect sinisterly smiled: 'Discovered? Hmph, the inheritance of the Tianji Record isn't determined by who discovers it.' Just as tensions reached the breaking point, all eyes fell on Chen Ji simultaneously. A servant disciple, standing all alone between the three factions of tigers and wolves, as if the next moment he would be torn to pieces."

dialogue.content: "Is that it? A servant of Tianqing Sect? Hmph, I thought it would be some formidable figure—get out of my way, don't block this old man from collecting treasures!"

text.content: "Han Lie's玄武法相 thrust out a claw,裹挟着足以碾碎金丹境的磅礴力量, directly at Chen Ji's face. In that instant, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve vibrated intensely—he felt an unprecedented death threat. The eyes of all three factions focused on this scene, some coldly laughing, some frowning, some watching indifferently. Han Lie's strike was clearly meant to kill him publicly, establishing his authority by stepping on his corpse."

dialogue.content: "(Suddenly raising his eyes, a sharp cold light flashing in his pupils) Han Lie, do you truly think... that I, Chen Ji, am a废物 to be slaughtered at will?"

text.content: "Just as the玄武巨爪 was about to fall, an aged yet commanding voice rang out from the void: 'Enough.' Ling Yuan's figure slowly emerged from the twisted spiritual energy, the old Sect Master's pressure like a mountain collapsing, instantly crushing Han Lie's attack into nothing. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment, the corner of his lips actually curving into a meaningful arc."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji? No, he died long ago. What stands before you is merely a remnant shadow projection he left behind—a failure whose very bones have turned to dust. What is there to fight over?"

text.content: "At these words, the three factions erupted in an uproar. Han Lie narrowed his eyes to examine Chen Ji, the Black Armored Commander and purple-robed cultivator exchanged a meaningful glance. Chen Ji felt the change in those gazes—suspicion, scrutiny, greed. Ling Yuan's move was brutal, pinning him with the 'dead man' label, making anyone who wanted to use him weigh whether they were conversing with a ghost. As for himself, he sat steadily in the fisherman's seat."

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan publicly declared you dead, the three factions show hesitation. You must break the deadlock—how will you respond?"

choices.text: "Continue acting under the name of a remnant soul"
choices.description: "Follow Ling Yuan's words, play the identity of 'remnant shadow projection,' secretly observe the three factions' true strength, and seek an opportunity to escape."
choices.visible_cost: "Must endure the humiliation of the 'dead man' label"
choices.risk_hint: "If exposed, will completely lose room for reversal"

text.content: "Chen Ji's face turned pale as he stepped back, his voice drifting: 'The 'remnant shadow' the old Sect Master mentioned... forget it, I should never have existed in this world.' He deliberately made his form slightly translucent, as if about to dissipate at any moment. This move of 'showing weakness' made the three factions even more doubtful—a remnant soul, what is there to fight over? But Chen Ji's peripheral vision was capturing every subtle reaction from each party."

dialogue.content: "(Coldly chuckling in his heart) Ling Yuan, you want to trap me with the identity of a 'dead man'? Then let me show you, dead men have their uses too."

choices.description: "Directly strike to prove you're alive, and expose the truth that Ling Yuan secretly plotted against you, making the three factions suspicious of the old Sect Master."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely expose your identity, fall into siege by three factions"
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan's credibility collapses, opportunity for three-faction alliance to crumble"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, spiritual energy surging around him, the 'remnant soul' disguise shattering like broken mirrors. He coldly lifted his right hand, gathering a blazing spiritual light in his palm—that was the blood energy power only a living person possesses. 'Remnant shadow projection? Ling Sect Master, what a big joke.' He turned to face the three factions, his voice sharp as an ice blade: 'Ask him, was the 'accident' three years ago arranged by his own hands?'"

dialogue.content: "(His expression changing drastically, a flash of astonishment and killing intent in his eyes) You are seeking your own death!"

choices.text: "Throw the secret of the Tianji Record to the three factions"
choices.description: "Reveal Ling Yuan's true purpose in fighting for the Tianji Record, implying 'whoever kills him will inherit the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record,' triggering internal strife among the three factions."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely offend Ling Yuan, become the target of all"
choices.visible_reward: "Three-faction alliance crumbles, opportunity to fish in troubled waters"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing in the silent ruins, carrying an indescribable irony. 'Ling Sect Master is right, I am someone who should die.' He paused, his gaze sweeping across the three factions, 'But do you gentlemen know what the true secret of the Tianji Record is?' Every ear perked up. 'It allows anyone who kills me to inherit my complete inheritance within the Tianji Record—including the ability to foresee three hours into the future.' Before the words even finished, Chen Ji clearly saw Ling Yuan's expression turn ashen."

dialogue.content: "(Eyes blazing with excitement) What did you say?! Killing you就能得到那能力?"

text.content: "The leaders of the three factions looked at each other, the previously tense hostility quietly transforming. Han Lie's玄武法相 no longer targeted Chen Ji but instead vaguely pointed toward Ling Yuan; the Imperial Court's Black Armored Commander's hand rested on his sword hilt, his gaze deep; even the purple-robed cultivator of the Demonic Path Holy Sect wore an amused smile. The cake of benefit was only one piece, and Ling Yuan clearly wanted it all. Chen Ji keenly caught this subtle change—he wanted exactly this effect."

dialogue.content: "(Grinding his teeth) Chen Ji, you scheming villain! Gentlemen, do not listen to his nonsense—the Tianji Record is the treasure of Tianqing Sect, how can outsiders covet it!"

text.content: "Ling Yuan's pressure suddenly erupted, attempting to crush all doubts with absolute strength. However, the three factions had long harbored different intentions—the Imperial Court wanted resources and strategic advantages, Xuanwu Sect wanted genius disciple cultivation and sect rise, and the Demonic Path Holy Sect wanted even more dark secrets too unspeakable to mention. This enticing piece of meat called the Tianji Record, no one was willing to hand over. The situation quietly reversed—Ling Yuan changed from 'arbiter' to 'the one being questioned.'"

choice.prompt: "The three factions' spearheads began pointing at Ling Yuan, but the old Sect Master's pressure remained terrifying. What's your next move?"

choices.text: "Pour oil on the fire, force him to strike first"
choices.description: "Continue provoking Ling Yuan, lure him into revealing flaws in his anger, letting the three factions see his 'hypocritical' true face."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely enrage Ling Yuan, battle may erupt early"
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan loses composure, three factions see his true nature"
choices.risk_hint: "If Ling Yuan goes berserk, you will become the primary target"

dialogue.content: "(Stepping forward, voice dripping with sarcasm) Why must Ling Sect Master be so agitated? I was merely helping everyone解答疑惑. Three years ago, who arrived at the scene first after my 'death'? And who hastily cremated my 'remains,' not even allowing fellow disciples to see the ashes? Sect Master, you are in such a hurry to make me 'thoroughly dead'—what exactly are you afraid of?"

choices.text: "Act as a peacemaker in the identity of 'the deceased'"
choices.description: "Pretend to mediate the three-faction conflict, adopt the posture of 'since I'm already dead anyway' to lower everyone's vigilance, take the opportunity to find a path of escape."
choices.visible_cost: "Must suppress anger, play the humble role"
choices.visible_reward: "Everyone relaxes vigilance, greatly increased chance of escape"
choices.risk_hint: "May be silenced by Ling Yuan under the guise of an opportunity"

text.content: "Chen Ji sighed softly, his tone carrying an indescribable melancholy: 'Forget it, forget it, fight if you must. I am merely a dying man.' He slowly retreated, 'Since I cannot protect the secret of the Tianji Record anyway, whoever wants it... go get it yourself.' These words seemed like showing weakness, but actually transferred the conflict—the three factions had always suspected each other, now each harbored ulterior motives, none willing to make the first move to benefit another."

"The atmosphere in the ruins became extremely heavy. The three factions appeared to be restraining each other on the surface, but undercurrents surged, everyone calculating how to maximize their own interests. And Chen Ji, this '废物' who should have been the target of all, became the most subtle chess piece in the three-faction game. Ling Yuan's killing intent in his eyes grew stronger, yet he hesitated due to the other two parties, not daring to act rashly. He spoke coldly: 'Gentlemen, the Tianji Record was passed down by Tianqing Sect's ancestors, outsiders must not covet it. Why don't we temporarily cease hostilities, capture this beast first, then discuss ownership?'"

dialogue.content: "(Coldly snorting) Capture? Your Tianqing Sect has quite the appetite. First you said he was dead, now you want to handle him personally—Ling Sect Master wouldn't be trying to monopolize it, would you?'"

text.content: "Han Lie's words were like a lit fuse, instantly igniting the already unstable alliance. The Imperial Court's Black Armored Commander stepped forward, his voice deep: 'Xuanwu Sect makes a valid point. Ling Sect Master's contradictory statements are truly hard to convince anyone.' The purple-robed cultivator of the Demonic Path Holy Sect sinisterly smiled: 'I am rather curious—about Chen Xiao You's claim that 'whoever kills him inherits the Tianji Record'... is it true or false?' His gaze like a venomous snake locked onto Chen Ji, 'Why not let this one verify it?'"

choice.prompt: "The Demonic cultivator intends to test you, all three factions' eyes are gathered. At this moment you must make a decision—"

choices.description: "Seize the moment when the Demonic cultivator is unprepared, activate the Tianji Record's foresight ability to predict his move's weak points, display strength that a '废物' should not possess before everyone."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume Heavenly Fate Value, expose some trump cards"
choices.visible_reward: "Shock the entire arena, make the three factions reassess your value"
choices.risk_hint: "The Tianji Record consumes heavily, and may provoke greater covetousness"

text.content: "The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve burned intensely hot, and Chen Ji unhesitantly activated its power—three breaths later, he clearly 'saw' the trajectory of the Demonic cultivator's killing move. 'Courting death.' He low-handed, his body surging forward, actually taking the initiative to meet that demonic arts technique sufficient to destroy a Golden Core realm cultivator. A palm strike, seemingly ordinary, but precisely hitting the biggest flaw in the Demonic cultivator's technique. 'Bang!' A muffled sound, the purple-robed cultivator stumbled backward, his eyes full of disbelief. 'This... this is impossible!'"

dialogue.content: "(Standing with hands behind his back, tone calm) 废物? If gentlemen still consider me a废物, feel free to come try again."

choices.text: "Fight while retreating, seek opportunity to escape"
choices.description: "Do not engage the Demonic cultivator head-on, use the gaps in the three-faction melee to break through and escape, prioritizing survival."
choices.visible_cost: "May be pursued, ending in a sorry state"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Heavenly Fate Value, save for future settlement"
choices.risk_hint: "If caught, may fall into even greater danger"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form flashed, actually not retreating but advancing, passing through the gap between the Demonic cultivator and the Black Armored Guards. His movement was bizarre, as if he had long calculated every step's landing point—that was precisely the three-breath advantage of Tianji Record's foresight. 'Stop him!' Ling Yuan shouted, but the three factions each had their own agendas, none willing to be the first to expose their strength chasing a '废物.' In that lightning flash, Chen Ji had already vanished into the shadows of the collapsed altar."

dialogue.content: "(Voice emerging from the shadows, lingering eerily) Gentlemen discuss slowly, Chen Mou will not accompany you."

text.content: "The three factions' leaders had varied expressions. The contempt in Han Lie's eyes had been replaced by a hint of wariness, the Imperial Court's Commander looked thoughtfully toward where Chen Ji disappeared, and the Demonic cultivator licked his lips, a more intense greed flickering in his eyes. Only Ling Yuan's face was dark as water, his eyes fixed死死 on the direction Chen Ji left, his fists in his sleeves clenched until they creaked. 'Chase!' he shouted, 'This beast is extremely cunning, absolutely cannot let him escape!' Yet not a single person from the three factions moved—each had their own calculations, none willing to do someone else's work."

dialogue.content: "(Grinding his teeth, voice pressed extremely low) Chen Ji... you had better pray you die cleanly enough. Otherwise when this old man catches you, I will make you wish for death!"

text.content: "Chen Ji traveled through the darkness, the temperature of the Tianji Record Fragment gradually cooling. He knew this escape was merely a temporary respite—Ling Yuan's killing intent was no longer concealed, the three factions' covetousness of him would not fade. But at least, he survived. He leaned against the cold stone wall, the corner of his lips curving into a cold smile: 'Ling Yuan, you think announcing my death can condemn me?' He slowly closed his eyes, 'The good show... is just beginning.' In the distance, the commotion of the three factions continued, while Chen Ji had quietly activated another chess piece—in the depths of the ruins, some long-sealed mechanism was emitting a faint humming sound."
